items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Fishman. Don't give him his price up there. He equipped to hit the street.

ctx.x: It's the only time I've ever seen that. That's something else.

He must be from the country somewhere, you know. Fishman. Don't give him his price up there. He equipped to hit the street. He do right. I got the guy sitting on here, come in. What you want from him? I want $0.30. I'll give you a dime. No. What's up? Get your money and see what you got left. Give it to the folks. I'm going to tell you straight. I could just imagine, I could just sit down here and just imagine, I could see all through Merlin Boys and over the Rhine, Spanish food man, West End, all in places. On…
Well who would the men dance with? I don't get that. Who would the men dance with?
